اضطهدت (form VIII)
# اِضْطَهَدْتُ (iḍṭahadtu) /idˤ.tˤa.had.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اِضْطَهَدْتَ (iḍṭahadta) /idˤ.tˤa.had.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اِضْطَهَدْتِ (iḍṭahadti) /idˤ.tˤa.had.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اِضْطَهَدَتْ (iḍṭahadat) /idˤ.tˤa.ha.dat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
